title: Kernel and spectral noise operators
statement: For every integer $n\ge 0$, every correlation parameter $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and every real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, the operator that averages the function against the independent coordinate noise kernel with keep probability $(1+\rho)/2$ equals the linear operator that multiplies each Walsh monomial of degree $|S|$ by $\rho^{|S|}$.
